texts.name: Sierra
texts.biography: Sierra believes that strength lies in alliances among individuals. She is known to travel from battlefield to battlefield, tirelessly seeking allies to join the cause. Her charismatic presence inspires others to embrace her kingdom, uniting diverse peoples under the banner of hope and unity.

specialty.name: Rogues
specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Rogue or Cutthroat for each level attained after 2nd level.
